feeds.name: Techmeme
feeds.use_when: Default for technology, AI, SaaS, startup, platform, and developer-tool profiles.
feeds.notes: Curated tech/business front page. High precision for major tech stories.

feeds.name: Google News Technology
feeds.use_when: Use as a broad technology backstop when Techmeme may be too narrow.

feeds.name: Google News Business
feeds.use_when: Use for business, funding, M&A, markets, commercial real estate, and executive-change profiles.
feeds.notes: Broad business feed; requires stricter relevance filtering.

feeds.name: Google News Science
feeds.use_when: Use for research, biotech, climate, space, and science-led profiles.
feeds.notes: Often useful for research-backed companies, less useful for generic SaaS.

feeds.name: Google News Health
feeds.use_when: Use for healthcare, digital health, biotech, pharma, and patient-safety profiles.
feeds.notes: High brand-safety risk; tragedy/human-suffering blocks still apply.

feeds.name: Google News U.S.
feeds.use_when: Use when U.S. policy, courts, or national regulation are central to the client.
feeds.notes: Broad and noisy. Avoid unless the client has policy standing.

feeds.name: Google News World
feeds.use_when: Use for geopolitics, supply chain, global markets, and international policy profiles.
feeds.notes: High tragedy/war exposure. Use only with direct public-interest standing.

feeds.name: Memeorandum
feeds.use_when: Use for U.S. politics, public affairs, policy, and media-politics profiles.
feeds.notes: Politically sensitive. Usually not appropriate for normal company newsjacking.

feeds.name: Mediagazer
feeds.use_when: Use for media, journalism, publishing, creator, and ad-tech profiles.
feeds.notes: Good companion to Techmeme for media-industry clients.

feeds.name: FTC Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for privacy, consumer protection, advertising claims, antitrust, and AI compliance profiles.
feeds.notes: Official source; slow but high authority.

feeds.name: SEC Press Releases
feeds.use_when: Use for fintech, crypto, public-company compliance, and investor-market profiles.
feeds.notes: Official source; useful for same-day expert commentary.

feeds.name: GOV.UK News
feeds.use_when: Use for UK policy, regulated industries, property, and public-sector profiles.
feeds.notes: Broad official UK feed; requires topic filtering by the skill.
